summary: Tested Scope3 EF default_unit feature end-to-end. Backend (create/update/get with default_unit), frontend (dropdown only shows allowed_units, view dialog shows default_unit, edit persists value), and calc engine context wiring all verified.

issues: Hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> is rendered directly inside <tbody>. Not caused by this feature, but surfaces in console on this page. Pre-existing; low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py Scope3EF duplicate check (lines 2029-2043 & 2074-2089) uses MongoDB equality on industry_sectors list — already sorted before compare, but note that an existing legacy doc whose industry_sectors was inserted unsorted would escape the duplicate check. Non-blocking for this feature.
/app/frontend/src/pages/Scope3EF.js is 1171 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting the form dialog into its own component.
In Scope3EF.js form submit (line 325) default_unit is sent as `formData.default_unit || null`, which converts empty string to null — correctly matches Optional[str] on backend.

Calc engine context key `scope3_ef_default_unit` is only set from `filteredScope3Activities.find(...)` — if scope3ActivityId points to an item not in the filtered list (filtering edge case), default_unit falls back to null and formula's expected_unit is used. This is the intended fallback behavior per the spec.
